A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]]. After failing to hold the [[crown prince of Thisspias]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], the governor was [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] by an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
